statement: In pinned f_hid, control-endpoint SET_REPORT is passed to the setup-report completion path when the OUT endpoint mode is disabled; SET_REPORT is rejected at setup when interrupt OUT mode is active. Userspace receives payload data through the character-device path, but the implementation does not expose an arbitrary per-report success or negative status to userspace before acknowledging a class request.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Host kernel f_hid control path only. Does not prove a particular DualShock 4 host sequence or exact software response.
